benefits.title: King’s creates a richer and more vibrant student life
benefits.statement: King’s campuses become more active settings for participation beyond scheduled study, with frequent, visible and low-friction opportunities to connect, explore, contribute and encounter something unexpected. The physical estate contributes more deliberately to belonging, community, opportunity, graduate futures and students’ sense of the value they gain from university life.
benefits.benefitType: physical participation, belonging and estate value
benefits.successLooksLike: Participation and dwell beyond scheduled study increase, student perceptions of campus vibrancy and community strengthen, and more students engage with activity encountered through campus-based invitations.

benefits.title: Students with different patterns of life and study can participate meaningfully
benefits.statement: King’s designs its wider student experience around the realities of commuting, paid work, caring, disability, placements, digital study and other materially different patterns of participation. A credible digital twin gives students who are less or never campus-present meaningful routes into communities, relationships, activity and opportunity rather than a thinner substitute for campus life.
benefits.beneficiary: Students with different patterns of presence, time and participation
benefits.successLooksLike: Participation becomes more equitable across different student forms, digital and blended participation grows in reach and depth, and students with lower campus presence report stronger access to community and wider opportunity.

benefits.title: King’s Edge is designed, commissioned and tested against the diversity of student lives
benefits.statement: Evidence-led student personas become a practical design, assurance and demand-setting tool across King’s Edge. They enable projects to test whether their propositions work for students with different patterns of time, presence, confidence and participation, and convert material gaps into clearer requirements or commissioning priorities through 2.2.4.
benefits.benefitType: inclusive design, assurance and responsive commissioning
benefits.successLooksLike: The personas are routinely used in design and assurance across King’s Edge; material gaps are identified and acted upon; and subsequent investment and commissioning can demonstrate how it responds to different forms of student life.
